notes: Units as stored in the files: power MW, energy MWh, thruster/gyro force N, mass kg, lengths m.
mass_kg = sum(count*component Mass). VERIFIED against public KeenSoftwareHouse MyCubeBlockDefinition.Init (mass += Count*Definition.Mass). Block inventories and attached cargo are not included.

integrity.sum_of_components = sum(count*component MaxIntegrity). VERIFIED (integrity += Count*MaxIntegrity; MaxIntegrity = integrity). An explicit <MaxIntegrity> in a block def overrides it (explicit_MaxIntegrity_override).

critical integrity: engine uses the cumulative integrity at the critical component (CriticalIntegrityRatio = criticalIntegrity / MaxIntegrity). integrity_before_critical_component is the sum of the components listed BEFORE the critical one; the engine value is approximately that (+/- one unit). INFERRED detail.

Weapons.sbc RateOfFire is rounds per minute and DeviateShotAngle is degrees converted to radians on load. VERIFIED against public MyWeaponDefinition.cs. ReloadTime/ShotDelay are milliseconds (INFERRED; the engine does not convert them).

derived_* fields are arithmetic on file values only. derived_block_dps = ProjectileMassDamage * shots/s * weapon DamageMultiplier (INFERRED that ProjectileMassDamage is the per-hit damage dealt to blocks).

Missile/railgun ammo: MissileExplosionDamage/Radius are explosion values; railgun slugs have 0 explosion damage and carry MissileHealthPool (the slug damage budget). How the engine converts HealthPool to block damage is NOT in the files.
World/session multipliers (BlockDamageModifier, WeaponsEnabled, ...) are session settings, not game data files: absent here.
Key order inside blocks[]: type/subtype matches tools/index_defs.py keys (defs.json); duplicates get #file suffix.
